checks.name: Search crosses server and workspace boundaries
Filtering uses stable ID despite duplicate names
Duplicate names visibly distinguished
Navigation leaves control and other-client selection unchanged
Rename preserves content and runtime identity
Agent identity alone means Unknown
Native model represents Ready
Native model represents Working
Native model represents Finished
Reading completion retains Finished and clears attention
Exact completion acknowledgment synchronizes across clients
Old displayed completion cannot acknowledge a later turn
Stale client acknowledgment cannot clear a later turn
Concurrent waits survive read, unrelated work and reverse completion
A completion cannot hide an outstanding question
Agent exit clears presence while terminal remains running
Exited terminal retained until tab closure
Delayed, repeated and wrong-owner events rejected
Prior agent incarnation cannot overwrite replacement agent
Malformed waits and unknown activities rejected without consuming sequence
Quiet healthy connection preserves Working
Reconnect transport alone cannot establish runtime freshness
Snapshot absence never deletes an item or stops a runtime
Deletion beats stale snapshots in either merge order
Runtime identity collisions cannot replace an existing session
Replacement requires fresh confirmed loss and a new identity
Reordered request resolutions buffer gaps and apply both
Unknown resolution cannot erase an unread completion
Resolving a request after completion preserves Finished attention
Repeated identity observation preserves reliable Working activity
A retired agent cannot return through a delayed identity report
Terminal exit is independent of agent incarnation
A stale snapshot cannot restore a retired agent incarnation
Confirmed loss merges at equal sequence and cannot be undone by later stale activity
Server names synchronize without borrowing connection freshness
New directory entries arrive stale
Concurrent rename fixture operations converge by stable operation identity
Ready snapshot cannot erase a finished turn in the same incarnation
Confirmed loss cannot relabel an already exited terminal
Buffered obsolete observations drain without wedging the next incarnation
A peer snapshot fills a gap and drains the next buffered report
A snapshot received offline drains reports only after reconciliation
Terminal exit discards buffered reports for the ended runtime
Concurrent replacement requests use one idempotent server allocation
Browser entries are searchable and navigate to their existing layout target without control
Agent reports cannot attach to browser content
Browser replacement preserves browser type and the layout target
AES-GCM encrypts current layout, activity, acknowledgments and tombstones
Envelope contains only public header fields and sealed bytes
Ciphertext modification rejected
Cross-account substitution rejected
Caller-supplied checkpoint floor rejects an older generation
Changing generation without resealing fails authentication
Local fixture expires a seven-day command file while retaining encrypted current state
Fresh native process restores encrypted state without other clients
Shared state does not serialize client-local navigation or control

scope: Native Swift reference model and CryptoKit filesystem/process checks; layout authorization, source ordering and trust checkpoints are fixture inputs. No real relay or distributed synchronization.
